title: Release drift counts commits that cannot change the tool, so it warns when nothing is missing
goal: susi workflow check and scripts/check-release-sync.sh both count every non-merge commit outside .agents/tasks. That over-counts: a test-only commit, a docs edit or a CI workflow change cannot alter what ~/.susi/bin/susi does, and hooks and scripts are read from the checkout rather than the release, so they are live either way. After the test-only fix for T-DEEPSEEK-72 merged, the installed 0.21.3 read as '1 commit behind origin/main' while the tool itself lacked nothing — the third false positive in this signal (merges and task records were the first two), and a warning that fires when nothing is wrong teaches agents to ignore it. Count only commits that changed what the binary is built from: src, crates, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml, build.rs.
